name: Wild Wyvern
description: A wing folded over the axis. Wyvern does not chase — it plants itself on the rim and makes the stadium come to it, then throws back whatever arrives.

special_move.name: Wyvern Wing Guard
special_move.description: The wings close, take the blow across their full span, and open again on the follow-through.
flavour_texts: 🛡️ **Wyvern Wing Guard** — the wings snap shut!

abilities.name: Wyvern Wall
abilities.description: Wyvern gives ground slowly: 14% off every incoming hit, and 20% of what still lands is sent back.
